description: This file is a Markdown documentation page that explains how to generate images during chat completions using the LiteLLM API. It includes code snippets (Python and Bash) demonstrating SDK usage, proxy setup, streaming, and async support for image generation in chat models. It also details the response structure, supported models, and provider info.

methods.name: completion
methods.description: Function to perform synchronous chat completion, with support for image generation and streaming.

methods.name: acompletion
methods.description: Asynchronous version of the completion function for chat completion with image generation.
